bullets: Mask Values are ADDED to Masked (Scaled) Values
Addition of "0" does not change the original values, consequently no effect on Softmax output
Addition of "-inf" gets "Zero" output of Softmax, leaving zero attention scores for future Words.
equations: Mask matrix (rows = query words, columns = key words): SOS: [0, -∞, -∞, -∞, -∞]; Je: [0, 0, -∞, -∞, -∞]; me: [0, 0, 0, -∞, -∞]; sens: [0, 0, 0, 0, -∞]; malade: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

layout.arrangement: White slide with a thin red rectangular border frame inset from the gray video background. Two-line red/blue title top-center. Yellow circular slide-number badge top-right corner. Softmax label + boxed equation top-right below the badge. Large blue-bordered diagram container in the center holding a 5x5 look-ahead-mask matrix with tilted column headers above and green row-label chips at its left; a dark-blue block arrow points at the matrix from the left margin. Full-width blue-bordered statement box near the bottom, followed by two lines of explanatory text below it. Thin black strip along the very bottom edge (video player chrome).

recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background white; place a light-gray (#E6E6E6) rectangle behind everything if mimicking the video frame, and draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle border inset ~6% from all slide edges. 2. Insert a top-center text box with two lines: 'Self Attention Look Ahead Mask' (Arial ~28pt bold, #C00000) and '(Used in  Decoder first Block )' (~22pt bold: parentheses and 'Used in' in #C00000, 'Decoder first Block' in #0000CC). 3. Top-right corner: draw a ~0.9cm yellow (#FFFF99) circle with red outline containing '53' in red bold. 4. Below it, type 'Softmax' in red bold; beneath it draw a white rectangle with a 2pt black border and insert the equation σ(x_j) = e^{x_j} / Σ_i e^{x_i} using PowerPoint's equation editor (italic serif, black). 5. Center: draw a large white rectangle with a 2pt blue (#0000CC) border (~37% slide width, ~55% height) as the diagram container. 6. Inside, above the matrix area, add five light-green (#DCF5DC) parallelogram shapes rotated 45° labeled left-to-right 'SOS', 'Je', 'me', 'sens', 'malade' (red bold text). 7. Left of the matrix area, stack five light-green rounded rectangles labeled top-to-bottom 'SOS', 'Je', 'me', 'sens', 'malade' (red bold). 8. Draw the matrix: a rounded rectangle with a red (#C00000) border; fill its lower-left triangle mint green (#DCF5DC) and upper-right triangle mauve (#A87C7C); draw a thin dark diagonal line from its top-left to bottom-right corner. 9. Overlay a 5x5 grid of 25 small light-yellow (#FFFFCC) squares with thin dark outlines. Type '0' (dark navy bold) in the 15 lower-triangle cells (including the diagonal) and '-∞' (red bold) in the 10 upper-triangle cells so the rows read: SOS [0,-∞,-∞,-∞,-∞]; Je [0,0,-∞,-∞,-∞]; me [0,0,0,-∞,-∞]; sens [0,0,0,0,-∞]; malade [0,0,0,0,0]. 10. Left of the container, add a solid dark-blue (#0000CC) right-pointing block arrow at mid-height. 11. Bottom: draw a full-width white rectangle with a 2.5pt blue border containing 'Mask Values are ADDED to Masked (Scaled) Values' (bold blue #0000CC, 'ADDED' underlined). 12. Directly below, add two bold text lines: 'Addition of "0" does not change the original values, consequently no effect on Softmax output' (with 'Addition of "0"' and 'no effect on Softmax output' in red, remainder dark navy) and 'Addition of "-inf" gets "Zero" output of Softmax, leaving zero attention scores for future Words.' (with 'Addition of "-inf"' in red bold and 'future' in red underlined, remainder dark navy). 13. Omit the bottom black strip and mouse cursor — they are video-recording artifacts, not slide content.
